---
title: "export_multiome_for_MultiVI"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-28"
---

This script exports the paired inputs MultiVI needs for NK and CD8 T cells, for PID 9 and 12:

* RNA raw counts (genes x cells), from `Seurat_RNA_ATAC_CD8_NK.rds`
* ATAC peak counts (peaks x cells), from the `PeakMatrix` in each cell-type ArchR project's Arrow files (`Data/NK`, `Data/CD8_T`)

Both matrices contain the same cells, in the same order.

Output, one folder per PID in `out_dir`: `rna_counts.mtx`, `rna_genes.tsv`, `atac_counts.mtx`, `atac_peaks.tsv`, `cells.csv`.
To read them in Python, use `scipy.io.mmread()` and build an AnnData.

```{r}
library(ArchR)
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
```

```{r}
data_dir <- "~/Research_2025/Gladstone/Data/"
out_dir  <- "~/Research_2025/Gladstone/MultiVI/MultiVI_input/"

PID.use      <- c(9, 12)
celltype_col <- "predicted.celltype.l1"
archr_dirs   <- c("NK" = "NK", "CD8 T" = "CD8_T")   # Seurat label -> ArchR project folder

dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Load the Seurat object (RNA raw counts + cell annotation)

```{r}
seurat_all <- readRDS(paste0(data_dir, "Seurat_RNA_ATAC_CD8_NK.rds"))
```

# Helper functions

```{r}
# Cell-name matching between Seurat and ArchR (same rule as archr-helper-functions-fixed):
#   Seurat : "BARCODE-1<suffix>"  ->  "PID#BARCODE-1"  (drop everything after "-<digit>")
#   ArchR  : already "PID#BARCODE-1" (sample name = PID), used as is
clean_cell_names_seurat <- function(cell_names, PID) {
  paste0(PID, "#", gsub("([A-Z]*-[0-9]).*", "\\1", cell_names))
}
clean_cell_names_archr <- function(cell_names) {
  cell_names
}

# Peak coordinates "chr:start-end" for the rows of a PeakMatrix SummarizedExperiment.
# Depending on the ArchR version, the coordinates are stored in rowRanges() or in rowData();
# if neither has them, read the feature table stored in the Arrow file (same row order).
peak_names <- function(se, arrow) {
  n  <- nrow(se)
  rr <- tryCatch(rowRanges(se), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is(rr, "GRanges") && length(rr) == n && any(width(rr) > 1)) {
    nm <- paste0(seqnames(rr), ":", start(rr), "-", end(rr))
  } else {
    rd <- as.data.frame(rowData(se))
    if (!all(c("seqnames", "start", "end") %in% colnames(rd)) || nrow(rd) != n) {
      rd <- as.data.frame(ArchR:::.getFeatureDF(arrow, subGroup = "PeakMatrix"))
    }
    stopifnot(nrow(rd) == n)
    nm <- paste0(rd$seqnames, ":", rd$start, "-", rd$end)
  }
  stopifnot(length(nm) == n, !anyDuplicated(nm))
  nm
}

# Peak matrix from one Arrow file (one PID, one cell-type project)
read_peak_matrix <- function(ct_dir, pid) {
  arrow <- path.expand(paste0(data_dir, ct_dir, "/ArrowFiles/", pid, ".arrow"))
  stopifnot(file.exists(arrow))
  se <- getMatrixFromArrow(ArrowFile = arrow, useMatrix = "PeakMatrix", binarize = FALSE)
  m  <- assay(se)
  rownames(m) <- peak_names(se, arrow)
  colnames(m) <- clean_cell_names_archr(colnames(m))   # ArchR names are "PID#BARCODE-1"
  m
}
```

# Export RNA counts and ATAC peak counts for each PID

```{r}
summary.list <- list()

for (pid in PID.use) {
  message("PID ", pid)
  seurat <- subset(seurat_all, subset = PID == pid)
  seurat <- subset(seurat, cells = colnames(seurat)[seurat@meta.data[[celltype_col]] %in% names(archr_dirs)])
  key    <- clean_cell_names_seurat(colnames(seurat), pid)
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(key))
  message("  example Seurat key: ", key[1])

  # ATAC peaks: NK and CD8 T projects (check that the peak sets are identical)
  pm.list <- lapply(archr_dirs, read_peak_matrix, pid = pid)
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(pm.list[[1]]), rownames(pm.list[[2]])))
  pm <- do.call(cbind, unname(pm.list))
  pm <- pm[, !duplicated(colnames(pm)), drop = FALSE]
  message("  example ArchR name: ", colnames(pm)[1])

  # keep cells present in both Seurat (RNA + annotation) and the ArchR PeakMatrix
  shared <- key[key %in% colnames(pm)]
  if (length(shared) == 0) stop("No Seurat cells matched ArchR cells - compare the example names printed above")
  ct     <- seurat@meta.data[[celltype_col]][match(shared, key)]

  # coverage report: how many annotated cells have a peak profile
  cov <- data.frame(
    PID        = pid,
    cell_type  = names(archr_dirs),
    n_seurat   = as.vector(table(factor(seurat@meta.data[[celltype_col]], levels = names(archr_dirs)))),
    n_matched  = as.vector(table(factor(ct, levels = names(archr_dirs))))
  )
  print(cov)
  summary.list[[as.character(pid)]] <- cov

  # RNA raw counts, same cell order
  rna <- GetAssayData(seurat, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  colnames(rna) <- key
  rna <- rna[, shared, drop = FALSE]
  if (any(rna@x != round(rna@x))) warning("RNA 'counts' slot is not integer - check it holds raw counts")

  atac <- pm[, shared, drop = FALSE]

  # write
  pid_dir <- paste0(out_dir, "PID_", pid, "/")
  dir.create(pid_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  writeMM(as(rna,  "CsparseMatrix"), paste0(pid_dir, "rna_counts.mtx"))
  writeMM(as(atac, "CsparseMatrix"), paste0(pid_dir, "atac_counts.mtx"))
  writeLines(rownames(rna), paste0(pid_dir, "rna_genes.tsv"))
  peaks <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(rownames(atac), "[:-]"))
  write.table(data.frame(peak = rownames(atac), chr = peaks[, 1], start = peaks[, 2], end = peaks[, 3]),
              paste0(pid_dir, "atac_peaks.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(data.frame(cell = shared, PID = pid, cell_type = ct),
            paste0(pid_dir, "cells.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

# Cell coverage summary

```{r}
coverage <- do.call(rbind, summary.list)
coverage
write.csv(coverage, paste0(out_dir, "cell_coverage.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
